artifact.archiveAndShaLocation: External ZIP, .zip.sha256 and .zip.receipt.json; archive hash is not embedded in its own source payload.

checks.adversarialFixtures: Known failure classes plus independently prepared fixtures; exact final logs recorded outside payload.
checks.repeatedBuild: Final gate requires byte-identical ZIP for the same source/candidate in two output directories.
checks.cleanArchive: Final gate requires verification before npm ci and a full check in an independently extracted copy with its own node_modules.
checks.gitHistory: Tip integrity plus known-credential/private/path checks of every new commit; safe intermediate commits may predate final release manifests.

limits: Stage4 exact Node/platform/RC matrix has not been performed here.
Known credential scan is bounded, not a complete security audit or proof of licensing.
Source root policy controls what is included; raw local-only backups and operational directories are excluded.
Archive profile is bounded classic ZIP STORE; no general ZIP/Zip64/encryption/symlink support claim.
External final-gate receipt identifies the exact completed archive and review results; do not infer its SHA from this internal document.
